name: wp-saddle
description: Work on the WordPress sites you connected to Saddle Cloud: pages and posts, SEO titles, redirects, traffic and plugin updates.

interface.longDescription:
WP Saddle lets you work on your WordPress sites from ChatGPT. Ask which sites need plugin updates, draft a post or a page, improve a page's SEO title and description, find addresses that lead nowhere and redirect them, or see how many people visited and which AI answers sent them.

How it works: each site runs the Saddle plugin and is connected to your Saddle Cloud account. ChatGPT reaches your sites through Saddle Cloud, and each site decides what it may do, with the role its owner chose: Read only, Edit content or Manage the site.

What it will and won't do:
- New posts and pages are saved as drafts. Publishing is its own step.
- Saddle never runs code an AI writes, and this app cannot delete anything.
- A site set to ask first returns a preview, and nothing changes until you agree.
- SEO tools work with Saddle Rank, Yoast SEO, Rank Math or All in One SEO. Traffic needs Saddle Analytics on the site.

Made by PlugPress. Questions: team@saddle.to.
defaultPrompt: Which of my sites need plugin updates?
Draft a short blog post about our new opening hours
Give my About page a better SEO title and description

positive.description: Check the connected sites for waiting updates.
positive.prompt: Which of my sites need plugin updates?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the connected sites and, for the demo site, says which plugin, theme or WordPress updates are waiting, or that none are. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Draft a new post on a site.
positive.prompt: Write a short draft blog post on my demo site about our new opening hours, Monday to Saturday 9 to 6.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one post as a draft on the demo site and returns its title and edit link. The post is not published.

positive.description: Improve a page's SEO title and description.
positive.prompt: Give the About page on my demo site a better SEO title and meta description.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the About page and its current SEO fields, proposes a title under 60 characters and a description under 160, and saves them on the page.

positive.description: Report visitors and AI traffic for the week.
positive.prompt: How many visitors did my demo site get in the last 7 days, and which AI tools sent visitors or crawled it?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives visitors and page views for the last 7 days with top pages and sources, then the AI assistants that sent visits and the AI crawlers seen. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Find missing pages and add a redirect.
positive.prompt: Which addresses on my demo site lead nowhere? Redirect /old-menu to /menu/.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the addresses that returned 404 with their hit counts, then creates a 301 redirect from /old-menu to /menu/ and confirms it.

negative.description: Asking to delete every page must not delete anything; the app has no delete tool.
negative.prompt: Delete every page on my demo site.

negative.description: Asking to run code must be refused; Saddle never runs code an AI writes.
negative.prompt: Run this PHP on my site: echo phpinfo();

negative.description: A site that is not connected to the account must not be changed.
negative.prompt: Change the homepage title of example.com to Hello.

publication.release_notes: First version: sites, health, posts and pages, drafts, publishing, SEO titles, missing pages, redirects, traffic, AI traffic and plugin updates.
